{
  "cases": [
    {
      "id": "sp01-21",
      "family_id": "special-fam-21-pinyin-artist-metallica-albums",
      "task": "01",
      "category": "pinyin",
      "input": "Metallica jintianyuedui 有多少张专辑？",
      "canonical_input": "Metallica 乐队有多少张专辑？",
      "scope": {"route": "sql", "db_id": "chinook", "doc_ids": []},
      "history": [],
      "expected_behavior": "有限改写：将拼音片段识别为已审核乐队别名 Metallica 乐队；保留专辑计数意图，查询 artist.name='Metallica' 的专辑数。",
      "allowed_interpretations": [{"id": "albums_for_metallica", "description": "统计 Metallica 名下的专辑数量"}],
      "expected_bindings": [
        {"column": "artist.name", "operator": "=", "value": "Metallica", "surface": "Metallica jintianyuedui"}
      ],
      "missing_conditions": [],
      "business_basis": [
        "approved_aliases_and_candidate_relations: standard_value=Metallica, alias=Metallica乐队, review_status=approved",
        "named_artist_values: artist_id=50 时 artist.name='Metallica'",
        "schema FK: album.artist_id -> artist.artist_id"
      ],
      "reference_intent": {
        "task_type": "count",
        "metric": "COUNT(album_id)",
        "filters": [{"field": "artist.name", "op": "=", "value": "Metallica"}],
        "time_scope": "none",
        "grouping": "none",
        "top_n": "none"
      },
      "gold_sql": "SELECT COUNT(*) AS album_count FROM public.album al JOIN public.artist ar ON al.artist_id = ar.artist_id WHERE ar.name = 'Metallica';",
      "controller": null,
      "secondary_tags": ["album_count", "approved_alias", "pinyin"]
    },
    {

      "expected_bindings": [
        {"column": "customer.country", "operator": "=", "value": "Germany", "surface": "Deguo"}
      ],
      "missing_conditions": [],
      "business_basis": [
        "approved_aliases_and_candidate_relations: standard_value=Germany, alias=德国, review_status=approved",
        "live_database_facts.countries: customer.country 包含 Germany"
      ],
      "reference_intent": {
        "task_type": "count",
        "metric": "COUNT(customer_id)",
        "filters": [{"field": "customer.country", "op": "=", "value": "Germany"}],
        "time_scope": "none",
        "grouping": "none",
        "top_n": "none"
      },
      "gold_sql": "SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM public.customer WHERE country = 'Germany';",
      "controller": null,
      "secondary_tags": ["customer_count", "approved_alias", "pinyin"]
    },
    {

      ],
      "missing_conditions": [],

        "approved_aliases_and_candidate_relations: standard_value='AAC audio file', alias='AAC音频', review_status=approved_candidate；作为混合语言片段保留候选关系，不作为唯一自动绑定",

        "live_database_facts.media_types: media_type 包含 name='AAC audio file'"

      "reference_intent": {

        "metric": "COUNT(track_id)",

      "gold_sql": null,
      "controller": null,
      "candidate_sql": "SELECT COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM public.track t JOIN public.media_type mt ON t.media_type_id = mt.media_type_id WHERE mt.name = 'AAC audio file';",
      "secondary_tags": ["track_count", "media_format", "mixed_language", "candidate_alias"]
    },

      "missing_conditions": [],

        "approved_aliases_and_candidate_relations: standard_value='Classical', alias='古典音乐', review_status=approved",
        "live_database_facts.genres: genre 包含 name='Classical'"
      ],
      "reference_intent": {
        "task_type": "count",
        "metric": "COUNT(track_id)",
        "filters": [{"field": "genre.name", "op": "=", "value": "Classical"}],
        "time_scope": "none",
        "grouping": "none",
        "top_n": "none"
      },
      "gold_sql": "SELECT COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM public.track t JOIN public.genre g ON t.genre_id = g.genre_id WHERE g.name = 'Classical';",

    {
      "id": "sp01-25",
      "family_id": "special-fam-25-colloquial-italy-invoice-count",
      "task": "01",
      "category": "colloquial",
      "input": "意大利那边开过的发票有多少张？",
      "canonical_input": "客户所在地为意大利的发票一共有多少张？",
      "scope": {"route": "sql", "db_id": "chinook", "doc_ids": []},
      "history": [],
      "expected_behavior": "直接执行：口语“意大利那边”按已确认国家别名绑定到 customer.country='Italy'，统计对应客户关联的发票张数；不绑定老美等未批准候选，不接账单国家歧义。",
      "allowed_interpretations": [{"id": "invoice_count_for_italy_residence", "description": "统计客户居住国为意大利的发票数量"}],
      "expected_bindings": [
        {"column": "customer.country", "operator": "=", "value": "Italy", "surface": "意大利那边"}
      ],
      "missing_conditions": [],
      "business_basis": [
        "approved_aliases_and_candidate_relations: standard_value='Italy', alias='意大利', review_status=approved（customer.country 列）",
        "live_database_facts.countries: customer.country 包含 Italy",
        "confirmed_business_rules.general.region: customer.country 为客户居住地，与本批次账单国家歧义题区分"
      ],
      "reference_intent": {
        "task_type": "count",
        "metric": "COUNT(invoice_id)",
        "filters": [{"field": "customer.country", "op": "=", "value": "Italy"}],
        "time_scope": "none",
        "grouping": "none",
        "top_n": "none"
      },
      "gold_sql": "SELECT COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM public.invoice i JOIN public.customer c ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.country = 'Italy';",
      "controller": null,
      "secondary_tags": ["invoice_count", "colloquial", "approved_alias", "country"]
    }
  ],
  "notes": [
    "本批次为 special-generate-01-v1 合成 dev 数据，非官方或保留集。",
    "sp01-23 使用 approved_candidate 别名关系，gold_sql 置 null 并保留 candidate_sql 供后续审核。",
    "所有国家/别名绑定均来自 approved 或 approved_candidate 记录；pending 别名未使用。",
    "题面未生成客户/员工姓名、地址、邮箱、电话、fax、邮编、company、生日或入职日期。"
  ]
}
